one_month_reasoning: The main event in the window is the September-quarter (FQ1'27) report, expected around Oct 21-22, 2026. Lam guided $8.10B +/- $0.4B revenue, 52% GM and $2.15 EPS, and management has since sounded more confident (Citi TMT Sept 9: WFE view raised to the low $150Bs, industry 'undersupplying demand', 8-10 tier-1 fabs through 2027). So a beat at or above the top of the range with a higher December guide is likely. But the stock is at ~34x NTM EPS and in September it swung between ~$279 and ~$325 on AI-capex pacing headlines, so how it reacts is close to a coin flip with fat tails. I centered the distribution slightly above spot (~$327) with ~18.5% monthly vol (65%/3.5). A peer AI-capex headline or new China/export rule could hit either way.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (FY Jun-2028 EPS ~$11.00 x 27x = $297, 60%) and FCF yield (NTM FCF ~$13.0B at 3.5% yield + ~$8B net cash over 1.24B shares = $316, 40%) -> ~$305 at Sept 2027.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: FY2028 (June-2028) EPS $11.00 x 27x forward P/E (what the market will capitalize in Sept 2027)

inputs_detail.derivation: Cross-checked vs Sept-26 quarter guide $2.15 +/-0.15 on 1.255B shares (source 1): run-rate $2.15-2.60/qtr sums to ~$9.5-9.7.

~15% growth on $9.60: mgmt expects CY2027 WFE to grow ('extraordinary setup', 8-10 tier-1 fabs through end-27, cleanroom constrained through 2027), DRAM fastest grower, NAND SAM/wafer 2x, mid-50s GM / mid-40s OM target; offset by tax rate rising to mid-teens and no view on 2028 WFE (CFO 'not going to put my neck out' on '28).

Today $324.5 / ~$9.6 NTM EPS = ~34x, near a cycle high for semicap; assume partial de-rating toward high-20s as the market starts discounting a possible 2028 WFE digestion year, while record margins and share gains (SAM -> high-30s% of WFE) justify staying above the ~20x mid-cycle.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM FCF $13.0B / 3.5% yield = $371B equity + $8B net cash = $379B / 1.24B shares

inputs_detail.derivation: FY27 net income ~ $9.60 x 1.25B = $12.0B; FCF conversion ~95-105% as FY26 capex step-up (Malaysia 2nd facility, Oregon labs) is absorbed; roll 1 year forward with ~10% growth.
June-26 cash $5.60B minus debt $3.73B = ~$1.9B; add ~$13B FCF less dividends (~$1.65B at $0.33/qtr) and buybacks (Q4 FY26 buyback slowed to $246M; assume ~$5B/yr).
Guide 1.255B for Sept-26 qtr; FY26 repurchased ~23M shares; at ~$300+ price and slower pace assume ~1% net reduction.
Current implied ~2.8% on NTM FCF (market cap ~$407B); peak-cycle semicap normally 4-5%; 3.5% reflects AI-driven visibility but some cyclical normalization.

bear.story: AI capex pacing (e.g., Sept-2026 'slow the pace' statements) turns into 2H-2027 order pushouts; market prices 2028 WFE decline; China domestic spending keeps falling or new export rules; EPS ~ $9 on 18x = ~$165.

base.story: CY2027 WFE grows ~10-15% constrained by cleanroom; Lam outgrows WFE on NAND conversions and DRAM, GM moves toward 53-54%; FY28 EPS ~$11 at ~28-29x as 2028 visibility stays murky.

bull.story: Cleanrooms open faster, DRAM/HBM and NAND capacity adds begin, 2028 also looks like a growth year; FY28 EPS ~$13-14 at ~34x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$200 (about -38%, under ~20x FY27 consensus EPS) the market would be pricing an actual WFE downturn in 2027-28 rather than a de-rating. That means cleanroom-constrained demand did not turn into orders (AI capex pause or memory price roll-over), or a major new export-control action. Either one breaks the 'cleanroom-constrained growth through 2027' thesis from the primary documents.

reasoning: Primary documents show a business at a record: June-qtr revenue $6.72B (+30% y/y), non-GAAP GM 52% (a 20-year high), Sept-qtr guide $8.1B (+20% q/q), EPS $2.15. The CY26 WFE view went from $135B to the low $150Bs. On the call and at Citi TMT (Sept 9), mgmt said 2027 WFE will grow with cleanroom as the binding constraint through 2027, but gave no view on 2028. Footnote-level detail the recaps skip: June-qtr buybacks fell to $246M (811k shares at $325) from ~$1.4B/qtr earlier; China fell to 26% of revenue as domestic customers declined; Japan shipments of $490M are still awaiting acceptance; deferred revenue rose to $2.43B; the tax rate is stepping up to mid-teens; insiders filed Form 144/4 sales through Sept. Valuation: at $324.5 the stock trades ~34x NTM EPS (~$9.6 consensus FY27) and ~2.8% FCF yield. My fair value of ~$305 assumes FY28 EPS ~$11 and a partial de-rating as the market looks at 2028 by Sept 2027. Semicap stocks usually de-rate before the WFE peak, and the Sept-2026 AI 'pacing' selloff shows how sensitive the multiple is. Base rates: realized vol is 65%, so I used ~52% for the main lognormal (median ~$325) plus a 12% weight on a downturn component (median ~$190) for the peak-cycle left tail. The result is a median ~$305, a mean ~$350, and P(>=spot) ~0.45. That is consistent with scenarios weighted 25/50/25 at $165/$320/$470. Research was limited: estimates APIs were rate-limited or paywalled, so consensus comes from one aggregator page.
